The '''Humbarine system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]]. It contained the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding members]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] passed through the [[Star system/Legends|system]] on their way to [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|fight]] the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] as part of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] carried out an [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that [[Death/Legends|depopulated]] Humbarine and [[Temperature/Legends|melted]] its crust. The Humbarine system became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and, more than four [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, saw the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|forces]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pass through in order to combat the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaders]] elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The Humbarine [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Humbarine sector/Legends|Humbarine sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Arrowhead]], [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was situated on the [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Trellen system/Legends|Trellen system]] as well as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]]. The Humbarine system contained the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] of the [[Humbarine/Legends|same name]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Ancient Republic system===
[[File:GSWRepublicToOnderon-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Galactic Republic naval forces passed through the Humbarine system during the Great Sith War.]]
Humbarine was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sleeper ship/Legends|colonization arks]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] of the nearby [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. In turn, Humbarine eventually established colony worlds of its own, leading to the formation of the region known as the Humbarine Rule<ref name="TEA" /> that would eventually also become known as the Humbarine [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CSWE HumbarineSector">{{CSWECite|II|67|Humbarine sector}}</ref> Once [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology was reverse-[[Engineer/Legends|engineered]] in the Core Worlds, Humbarine was among the planets that sent [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] out in [[Star map/Legends|uncharted]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] searching for potential new worlds to claim. Humbarine became one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding members]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="TEA" /> upon that government's [[Galactic Constitution Conference|establishment]] in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Humbarine and its [[Star/Legends|star]] system also remained loyal to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars that [[First Alsakan Conflict|erupted]] around [[17,018 BBY]] and pitted the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and its allies against those of Coruscant in a struggle for [[Politics/Legends|political]] control over the Republic.<ref name="EGTW" /> During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] passed through the Humbarine system on their way to [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|engage]] the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Humbarine system was among the Core systems that remained inside the<ref name="TEA" /> greatly diminished<ref name="EGTW" /> territory of the Republic during the [[Light and Darkness War|final phase]] of the [[New Sith Wars]] leading up to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Humbarine [[Bank/Legends|bank]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Jonmor Tinto]] was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the Republic for embezzlement. After Tinto was eventually released from prison, he and other ex-convicts established a settlement on the<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> world [[Longwind]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter Code" />

===Clone Wars and onward===
[[File:General_Grievous_NEC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|General Grievous subjected Humbarine to a devastating orbital bombardment.]]
During the Clone Wars, the Humbarine system remained within Republic borders<ref name="TEA" /> and, during the first campaigns of the conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Second Army|Second Sector Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the system's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" /> Despite that, Humbarine, left by the inefficiencies of the Republic [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]] with insufficient resources for its own protection, came under repeated devastating attacks led by Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="DB Oicunn">{{DB|character|ltoicunn|Oicunn, Lieutenant}}</ref> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] featuring the Humbarine system was displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

Ultimately, around [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]],<ref name="BombardmentDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], which&mdash;along with the [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|bombardment of Humbarine]]&mdash;is established by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' to have been a part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]].</ref> Grievous's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']],<ref name="DB TradeFederationCruiser">{{DB|starship|tradefederationcruiser|Trade Federation cruiser}}</ref> subjected Humbarine to an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]-long [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that [[Death/Legends|depopulated]] the world and [[Temperature/Legends|melted]] its crust.<ref name="CSWE InvisibleHand">{{CSWECite|II|110|''Invisible Hand''}}</ref> The Humbarine sector's [[Planetary Security Forces|defense force]] junior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Barrow Oicunn/Legends|Barrow Oicunn]], who hailed from Humbarine, survived the event, as did<ref name="DB Oicunn" /> Humbarine's native<ref name="DB Breemu">{{DB|character|banabreemu|Breemu, Bana}}</ref> Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]] of the Humbarine sector. Oicunn was eventually transferred to the [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|Coruscant Home Fleet]].<ref name="DB Oicunn" /> After the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Humbarine system was located within its territory.<ref name="EGTW" />

The population of the Humbarine system numbered between ten and one hundred million around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] passed through the system on their way to [[Battle of Fondor|engage]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaders]] at the Colonies' [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]]. They also did the same [[28 ABY/Legends|three years]] later when preparing for a [[Battle of Ebaq|confrontation]] with the Yuuzhan Vong in the [[Treskov system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Humbarine, and therefore the star system it was in, was first placed on a map included in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It first appeared in the non-[[canon]]ical [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Mind Tricks]]''.<ref name="JMT">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Mind Tricks]]''</ref>

Published on [[August 18]], 2009,<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by Wallace and [[Jason Fry]] identified the Humbarine system by name and placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first canonical appearance of the system with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AoI" />
